pli-tv-bu-vb-pc43:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc43:1.2: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Upanando Sakyaputto sahāyakassa gharaṃ gantvā tassa pajāpatiyā saddhiṃ sayanighare nisajjaṃ kappesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc43:1.3: atha kho so puriso yenāyasmā Upanando Sakyaputto ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Upanandaṃ Sakyaputtaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc43:1.4: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so puriso pajāpatiṃ etad avoca: dadeh' ayyassa bhikkhan ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc43:1.5: atha kho sā itthi āyasmato Upanandassa Sakyaputtassa bhikkhaṃ adāsi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc43:1.6: atha kho so puriso āyasmantaṃ Upanandaṃ Sakyaputtaṃ etad avoca: gacchatha bhante yato ayyassa bhikkhā dinnā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc43:1.7: atha kho sā itthi sallakkhetvā pariyuṭṭhito ayaṃ puriso 'ti āyasmantaṃ Upanandaṃ Sakyaputtaṃ etad avoca: nisīdatha bhante mā agamitthā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc43:1.9: tatiyam pi kho so puriso āyasmantaṃ Upanandaṃ Sakyaputtaṃ . . . dinnā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc43:1.10: tatiyam pi kho sā itthi āyasmantaṃ Upanandaṃ . . . mā agamitthā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc43:1.11: atha kho so puriso nikkhamitvā bhikkhū ujjhāpeti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc43:1.12: ayaṃ bhante ayyo Upanando mayhaṃ pajāpatiyā saddhiṃ sayanighare nisinno,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc43:1.13: so mayā uyyojiyamāno na icchati gantuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc43:1.16: kathaṃ hi nāma āyasmā Upanando Sakyaputto sabhojane kule anupakhajja nisajjaṃ kappessatīti --pa--.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc43:1.17: saccaṃ kira tvaṃ Upananda sabhojane . . . kappesīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc43:1.20: hi nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa sabhojane . . . kappessasi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc43:1.21: n' etaṃ moghapurisa appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc43:1.22: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc43:1.23.1: yo pana bhikkhu sabhojane kule anupakhajja nisajjaṃ kappeyya, pācittiyan ti. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc43:2.1.6: itthi c' eva hoti puriso ca itthi ca puriso ca ubho anikkhantā honti, ubho avītarāgā.

pli-tv-bu-vb-pc43:2.1.11: khuddake ghare piṭṭhivaṃsaṃ atikkamitvā nisīdati, āpatti pācittiyassa. ||1||
